items.label: Existing-boss phase / mobility / Brutal quality passes
items.status: Twelve original encounters have implemented phase/mobility/advanced-form quality passes; 48 remain and whole-boss human acceptance remains0. Human5206 finds Bellringer Counterpoint pressure sufficient, possibly much harder than Alchemist; Standard calibration and a distinct Brutal technique are pending. Alchemist is praised as the first unique encounter; a stronger themed Crazed step is pending. Shared phase-attack continuity is a separate system pass and adds no quality credit.

items.label: Ability-changing class-upgrade revamps
items.status: Three actual ability transformations per class (21 total) implemented at existing utility-path depth three, with shared authority, cues and fifteen-locale help. Rendered/human balance/device/native-language acceptance remains open.

items.label: Optional large branching skill-tree view
items.status: Optional all-54-skill map implemented for all seven classes with settings toggle, bounded zoom, scrolling and keyboard navigation. Classic remains the default; rendered/human/device/native-language review remains open.

items.label: Secondary-map topology revamps
items.status: Five distinct secondary layouts installed. Four spacious maps now have compact real geometry; Ossuary/Crown routes retain their size. Difficulty cover/lava, movement and prediction remain shared. Human 5185 feedback motivated the compact pass; its rendered/human/device comparison remains open.

items.label: Map ground-art deliveries
items.status: Six ground deliveries installed. Limited Normal/Constable readability feedback is positive.

items.label: Early Watch motion and encounter integration
items.status: Three encounters, 36 selected poses, individual themes and fifteen-locale help implemented. Limited 5179 phase/pacing feedback informed the new two-phase/difficulty pass; its human comparison, rendered and listening review remain open.

items.label: Small Wakes motion and encounter integration
items.status: Three original two-phase encounters, 36 selected poses, individual scores and fifteen-locale help implemented. Rendered/human balance/device/native-language/listening acceptance remains open. Limited 5185 human comparison confirms clearer phases and harder Brutal, with arena retreat feedback still requiring review.

items.label: Crazed form integration
items.status: All 66 identities have purple C treatment, inherited Brutal signatures, forced Hellish and persisted Endless progression. Projectile-bearing techniques retain 2.5x/7.5x budgets. Alchemist and Bellringer replace common bullet/laser pressure with their owned chemistry/acoustic techniques; the other 64 retain current common pressure pending individual quality work. No roster credit; human balance/rendered/device acceptance remains open.

items.label: Committed attacks across phase boundaries
items.status: Shared authority retains warned/released attacks, target locks, weak points, temporary terrain and minions through phase entry on every difficulty. Committed custom scores retain their issuing phase; fresh casts wait through the phase grace/optional assistance. Earned shield breaks, genuine weak-point interruptions, natural expiry and encounter cleanup remain. Full current-source verification and human review are recorded separately; no new boss-quality or roster credit.

items.label: Mold Alchemist Crazed difficulty step
items.status: The user clarified that the small Brutal-to-Crazed jump concerns Mold Alchemist. Its chemistry is praised as unique; retain Normal/Brutal identity and add a stronger themed Crazed step. No fixed-grade reclassification or completed tuning is claimed.

items.label: Bellringer Standard calibration / distinct Brutal technique
items.status: Latest human5206 feedback confirms sufficient pressure but a possible Standard overshoot relative to Alchemist; Brutal still feels like more volume. Ease Standard overlap/reach/timing and add a genuinely distinct warned Brutal technique inherited by Crazed. A thrown clapper reeling back on a warned chain is proposed, not implemented. Fixed grade3- remains.

items.label: Shared General mobility skill branch
items.status: User requests a shared branch available to every class, including Double Dash and Sprint. Proposed second dash charge and stamina-limited sprint use the existing earned SP budget; exact node design is pending. Needs authority/prediction, saves/online isolation, menus/skill-map integration, keyboard/touch/gamepad/accessibility and fifteen-locale help. Bosses must remain viable without requiring these purchases; no extra class or free SP is claimed.

latestHumanFeedback: Human5206: revised Bellringer now creates enough pressure, possibly substantially more than Alchemist. Its Standard calibration needs review and Brutal needs a distinct mechanic beyond additional volume. The proposed thrown-clapper return-chain technique is pending; no fixed-grade reassignment is requested.

The user proposes a General skill branch shared by all seven classes, with Double Dash and Sprint. The recommended second charge and stamina-limited sprint would spend the existing SP budget. No nodes, free budget or new class are implemented in this continuity pass.

Phase-entry attack persistence is now implemented as shared ownership. Software tests and controlled samples are separate from human balance/rendered/device acceptance; successful player-earned interruption remains meaningful.

Human5204: Bellringer walking seemed aimless, sound generic, and the single-wave pattern too simple even for grade3-. Crazed was beatable without upgrades and its deployed bell merely replaced the primary attack. Counterpoint adds approaches toward survivors, overlapping primary/response peals, warned clapper sectors and distinct actual-strike tones; new rendered/human difficulty comparison remains open.

The user clarified that Mold Alchemist is the first boss they found truly unique. Relative to the weak Bellringer, its challenge felt much higher; this is comparative feedback, not a requested fixed-grade reassignment. Its Normal-to-Brutal jump is stronger than Brutal-to-Crazed; a stronger themed Crazed revision is pending.

New request: warned or already released attacks should still land when a boss crosses a phase boundary, on every difficulty. This is recorded as a separate pending authority task; Counterpoint retains the existing cleanup behavior and does not claim to implement it.

Latest 5200 human comparison found Alchemist reactions visible but weak, self-tossed vials and green cleared areas without useful purpose, sliding without drawn walking, and phase/form differences mainly bullets/lasers. The requested follow-up is the Alchemist laboratory revision; new human/rendered/balance acceptance remains open.

The user wants each boss to rely on unique techniques grounded in its theme; not all bosses should spam projectiles. Phase and advanced-form identity must change decisions, not just quantities. Global projectile multipliers apply to projectile-bearing techniques, while bosses may use other owned mechanics.

Personal browser testing is authorized, but supported CUA reports disabled access in Work settings. Do not retry or bypass. Earlier scoped observations remain separate; current Alchemist laboratory revision has no rendered or personal-clear acceptance. The approval-review usage failure recovered and is recorded separately.

The user explicitly revoked the earlier browser-control restriction and authorized personal browser testing. Preserve historical evidence as issued; record actual browser observations separately from simulations and human/device/listening/native-language/final balance acceptance.

Testing/public separation, local coin/SP tools, difficulty unlock, optional names/chat and a visible records surface are implemented. New follow-up human comparison remains open.

New timing/status/random-choice human comparison remains open; this is limited positive feedback, not whole-boss final acceptance.

Human comparison on frozen 5190 liked the Clerk shelter purpose and rim effect. This is positive limited feedback, not final whole-boss acceptance. The requested follow-up uses 3/5/10 Standard/Brutal/Crazed seals, doubled-damage purple triangles and Crazed black skulls removing 75% of current health once per activation with a 1HP floor. Later 5191 feedback is recorded above; current follow-up acceptance remains open.

The follow-up now pairs each reopening with a fully warned fan from the two other seals and real rim interception cues; human comparison remains open.

Finished-product availability remains optional Baby-only; all-difficulty guides remain in testing builds; public builds use optional Baby-only guides.

Requested smaller maps, a more atmospheric boss header, forced Insane Brutal, forced Hellish Crazed with purple/C treatment, higher projectile budgets and Standard-to-Brutal-to-Crazed Endless progression; phase sound and later bespoke animation were also requested.

Requested phase shield-break only on Baby/Easy Standard, no shield event in Brutal, full-health Baby revival, half-health Easy and quarter-health Normal revival, and no combat revives at Hard or above. One authority policy and fifteen-locale difficulty cards now implement these rules.
